in-world-nashik-valley.basis: Nashik Valley wine is a registered GI (2010); the outline is Nashik district.
in-world-nashik-valley.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.

outline_source.name: geoBoundaries IND ADM2 (2021)

in-world-nashik-valley.atlas_note: Plateau north-east of Mumbai at 500 to 700 m that produces most of India's wine. Vines are pruned so that the harvest falls in the dry winter months.
